column3: Saori Route ・ Kyousuke-shi is Suspicious
Could it be, Kyousuke-shi...
That you're doubting me?
N-No such thing. I'm just worried about you.
Do you really think that I've been calling you and waiting for you in chatrooms out of mere curiosity...?
Replacing someone on their appointment, showing in their stead at the meeting place?
Yes.
An instant reply?!
I didn't say it's bad to do it out of mere curiosity. I am extremely honored by that.
Then, why aren't you talking to me?
Do you still remember what I said to you at the maid cafe back then?
I had to go for an marriage interview, and...
Marriage interview...
That's right. We went to Akihabara after the Siscaly tournament, and she spilled that inadvertently.
This marriage interview, is that what Saori was anxious about recently?
But what did she say at that time?
She laughed it off as if it was a joke, didn't she?
It feels like I should say something, but I can't think of anything suitable to say...
Saori may look huge, but she's actually younger than me.
Despite that, I got a glimpse of a world that is unknown to me.
Surely, she must feel disheartened.
At that time, didn't you say it was just a "life experience"?
I thought it would just be a life experience.
Even so, I should have said it.
In that case, don't make such a sad smile...
You mean, that marriage interview is a serious thing...?
Really really very serious.
But, it was only a marriage interview, right?
It's not like you have to settle down; if you end up rejecting it, it'll work out...
Eh, what's with the silence?
Actually...
I have to uphold the honor of my parents, so... I'm... getting engaged.
...............Are thou serious?
I am serious.
B-But, nothing's finalized yet...?
...Even the reservations for the ceremonial hall have been placed.
Seriously...?
Kyousuke-shi... It's really hard to say, but...
I'd like to have this Life Consultation for once.
I had a little premonition about this, but I never expected even Saori would ask for a life consultation in the end...
Okay. You'll have to explain this first.
Actually, my fiance said that he wanted me to drop my otaku hobby.
I too am kind of bothered by that.
I see...
But your family is pretty wealthy, isn't it?
Couldn't you just turn down the request to stop your hobby?
The person in this marriage interview is the son of a family who owns a big listed company.
He's doing very well in his career, is very well-mannered, and his speech is intelligent-sounding and charming...
Furthermore, his future annual income would be tens of millions.
Whoa... That can't be real...!
That's that, right? The one of a kind treasure?
Even though I'm a man, those qualities are making my heart beat faster.
So wouldn't a woman rush straight for it?
But he's almost 40.
That's the bit that rules out everything!
Age doesn't matter in love...
That may be true, but...
But this is an marriage interview, right? Any affection and love haven't even started.
Still, I have to accept for the sake of my parents' honor.
Parents' honor, huh...
It isn't a world I'm familiar with; for Saori, it's a family matter.
He told me to dispose of all my otaku goods, but...
No matter what, I couldn't bear to throw away the treasures filled with memories.
Because of that, you passed those goods to Kirino and me?
Yes...
If it's Kyousuke-shi and Kiririn-shi, I thought I could entrust my memories to you.
However, I'm really sorry for causing both of you trouble.
Nope, you did it because you trusted us, right?
Then it isn't considered a bother.
...I am very grateful.
But, regarding the engagement...
I'm sorry, but I can't say anything about it.
If they are engaged, then it's an issue between the two.
No matter how much she trusts me, I'm an outsider. It's not good to intrude.
This should be a matter of mutual agreement.
But, even after getting married, completely rejecting your lifelong partner's hobby is something that I can't accept.
Kyousuke-shi...?
It's marriage... right?
It's completely different from a casual date.
Do you plan to live the rest of your life as dictated by your husband?
That's...
That's something I definitely don't want...!
Then it's decided. I shouldn't be the one keeping your treasures.
You should have your fiance understand your otaku hobby!
Hmm? You look like you have something to say?
Well, I have a mountain full of them.
Come to think of it, when Saori rejected my gifts, she looked really dejected.
...Surely from then on, it would be impossible to get more figures...
Is that a result of the marriage interview?
Did Saori come to a resolution of sorts?
You said, a future that will never be granted...
Were you referring to this?
Yes, I was.
I was told to leave my otaku hobby behind by my marriage prospect.
As I thought...
The person in this marriage interview is the son of a family who owns a big listed company.
He's doing very well in his career, is very well-mannered, and his speech is intelligent-sounding and charming...
Furthermore, his future annual income would be tens of millions.
Whoa... That can't be real...!
That's that, right? The one of a kind treasure?
Even though I'm a man, those qualities are making my heart beat faster.
So wouldn't a woman rush straight for it?
But he's almost 40.
That's the bit that rules out everything!
Age doesn't matter in love...
That may be true, but...
But this is an marriage interview, right? Any affection and love haven't even started.
Still, I have to accept for the sake of my parents' honor.
Saori fell silent with a painful sigh.
This is where I reached a possibility.
Due to the appearance of her marriage prospect, Saori grieves the fact that she won't be able to marry the one she really loves?
And thus, she stubbornly refused to confide to me about those private circumstances?
Well, that kind of joke is interesting from time to time!
Damn it! That's like a modern day Romeo and Juliet!
Err, Kyousuke-shi...? It's an abrupt question, but...
Listening to the conversation, just where did you pull that Romeo and Juliet from?
No, you don't have to say anything, I understand.
Leave it to me for now. You just have to fail the marriage interview, right?
Kyou-Kyousuke-shi! Your voice is too loud!
Do you think I can stay silent about this?!
Do you like this marriage prospect? Do you love him?!
That's...
Okay, it's decided. Now guide me this guy's house.
Eeeh?!
But, Saori. It's marriage, right?
It's not just going out with someone.
This... is deliberate.
Do you mean that you intend to live the rest of your life as a maid listening to the orders of her master?
Are you going to lie about your feelings and blow your life for your parents' sake?
Are you fine with such a life?!
I... I can't accept those conditions!
Then it's decided!
In the end, I can't accept your treasure.
He'll have to understand about your otaku hobby!
Do you plan to live the rest of your life while sealing your otaku hobby away?!
Yes...
Yes, you say... Is that really fine with you?
Can you really give up on your way of life so easily?
Is the appearance of a marriage prospect enough for you to throw away your otaku hobby?
Is it fine to throw away the trigger behind Kirino and Kuroneko's encounter?!
Don't simply follow in silence with your head low.
But...
Don't you understand after this?
In that case, I'll say it directly.
EEEH?!
Take me to that marriage prospect's house. Right away.
Kyousuke-shi! This is much too reckless!
Shush! Today, I made up my mind!
Ready, GO!!
THEEEEEEE-HECKKKKKK
